arabic text: ASGHAR JIYE GI KESE,TERE BAGAIR MAA
english translation text: O my speechless child, where have you remained? How will your mother live without you, Asghar?

arabic text:
●HAYE ASGHAR MERE ASGHAR,HAYE ASGHAR MERE
ASGHAR
AE RAAJ DULARE ASGHAR,MAA TUJH KO PUKARE
ASGHAR
MERI ANKH KE TARE ASGHAR,AAJA MERE PYARE ASGHAR
AEY MERE BE ZUBAN,TUM REH GAYE KAHAN
ASGHAR JIYE GI KESE TERE BAGAIR MAA
english translation text:
Alas, Asghar, my Asghar. O
beloved prince, your mother calls
you. O light of my
eyes, come, my beloved.
O speechless child, where are
you? How will your
mother live without you, Asghar?

arabic text: ●CHEHRA WO CHAAND JAISA,KAISE BHULAI MAA\nASGHAR JIYE GI KESE TERE BAGAIR MAA
english translation text: How can a mother forget that moonlike face?\nHow will your mother live without you, Asghar?

arabic text:
●KIYA WAQT AGAYA HAI,BANO KI BEKASI PER
GURBAT PE TERE MATAM,KAISE KAISE KAREGI KI MADAR
AADA NE BANDH DI HAIN,HATHON MAI RASIYAN
ASGHAR JIYE GI KESE TERE BAGAIR MAA
english translation text:
What a time has come upon Bano's helplessness.
How many ways will your mother mourn your exile?
The enemies have bound ropes around her hands.
How will your mother live without you, Asghar?

arabic text:
●HIMMAT PE MAA TUMHARI,QURBAN KYUN NA JAYE
SUNTI HAI TEER KHA KER,TUM RAN MAI MUSKURAI
MADAR KI LAAJ RAKH LI,SHABASH MERI JAAN
ASGHAR JIYE GI KESE TERE BAGAIR MAA
english translation text:
Why should I not be sacrificed for your courage?
I hear that after receiving the arrow, you smiled in the battlefield.
You preserved your mother's honour—well done, my life.
How will your mother live without you, Asghar?

arabic text:
●MADAR KI HAI WASIYAT,BETA KHAYAL RAKH
GODI MAI IN KI ASGHAR,JANE KI ZID NA KARNA
PEHLE HEE HAIN SHIKASTA,DADI KI PASLIYAN
ASGHAR JIYE GI KESE TERE BAGAIR MAA
english translation text:
This is your mother's instruction: my son, take care.
Do not insist upon entering Grandmother's lap;
her ribs are already broken.
How will your mother live without you, Asghar?

arabic text: ●KIYA ZER R KHAAK AB BHI SOYE HO MUN CHUPAI\nMAA SARI BIBIYON SE,SHARMINDA HO NA JAYE
english translation text: Are you still beneath the dust, hiding your face?\nMay your mother not become ashamed before all the ladies.

arabic text: HAR IK SHAHEED KA HAI,SAR BAR SAR E SINA\nASGHAR JIYE GI KESE TERE BAGAIR MAA
english translation text: Every martyr's head is upon a spear.\nHow will your mother live without you, Asghar?

arabic text:
●DUSHWAR HOGAYA HAI,RAN MAI TUMHARA JEENA
AB KHALI GOD JAA KER,MAA KIA KRE MADINA
MUJH KO WOHIN BULA LO,AE LAAL HO JAHAN
ASGHAR JIYE GI KESE TERE BAGAIR MAA
english translation text:
Living in the battlefield became impossible for you.
What will your mother do when she returns to Madina with an empty lap?
Call me to wherever you are, my son.
How will your mother live without you, Asghar?

arabic text:
●SANSEIN TO CHAL RAHI HAIN,ZINDA KAHAN RAHI HAI
MAA ZINDAGI SE APNI,AZADI CHAHTI HA
MUSHKIL KHUSHA HO TUM BHI,KHULWADO BERIYAN
ASGHAR JIYE GI KESE TERE BAGAIR MAA
english translation text:
My breaths continue, but I am no longer alive.
Your mother longs for freedom from life.
You too are a remover of difficulties—have these shackles opened.
How will your mother live without you, Asghar?

arabic text:
●JANGLE MAI IK BETA,AWAZ GHUNJTI HA
YEH SOCH KER BHI MADAR,MAQTAL MAI RO RAHI HA
LAGTA HAI DARD SE TUM,LETE HO SHISKIYAN
ASGHAR JIYE GI KESE TERE BAGAIR MAA
english translation text:
A son's cry echoes through the wilderness.
Thinking of it, the mother weeps within the battlefield:
it feels as though you still sob in pain.
How will your mother live without you, Asghar?

arabic text:
●YEH UJRI GOD BETA,KESE SUKOON PAYE
HALAT PE TERI MAA KI,HANSTE HAI SHAAM WALE
DAMAN MAI HAIN TUMHARE,JHOOLE KI LAKRIYAN
ASGHAR JIYE GI KESE TERE BAGAIR MAA
english translation text:
How can this emptied lap find peace, my son?
The people of Shaam laugh at your mother's condition.
Only pieces of your cradle remain in her garment.
How will your mother live without you, Asghar?

arabic text:
●ROTE THY SUB TAQALLUM,IK MAA NE JAB KAHA THA
PAIGHAM KARBALA MAI,JAKER HAWA YEH DENA
ZINDAN KE DAR PE AB BHI,BETHI HAI IK MAA
ASGHAR JIYE GI KESE TERE BAGAIR MAA
english translation text:
O Taqallum, everyone wept when a mother said:
O wind, go to Karbala and deliver this message:
a mother still sits at the prison door.
How will your mother live without you, Asghar?
